mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has improved monotonically from -8.3% to -3.4% over four weeks, signaling a sustained recovery trend. This momentum continues linearly into the next four weeks, producing net positive RETAIL_REC relative to the prior baseline period.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 4.9 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean of the prior 28 days, or reverses by more than 2 percentage points in any single week.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility remains elevated at 40.0%, indicating sustained essential-goods shopping behavior. This persistent demand for essential trips anchors foot traffic patterns and prevents retail-recreation mobility from falling further below baseline over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 30% in any week during the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines by more than 3 percentage points from t-0w baseline.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has improved from -6.7% to -3.1% over four weeks. If TRANSIT continues to recover above -2.0% in the next two weeks, commuting normalization will drive retail-recreation footfall upward by enabling access to shopping districts.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves above -2.0% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 3.6 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT remains below -3.0% for more than two weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines despite TRANSIT recovery.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated at 5.7%, indicating continued work-from-home or mobility restrictions. When RESIDENTIAL falls below 5.0%, restrictions are loosening; this triggers increased retail-recreation mobility as people resume in-person activities.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL does not fall below 5.0% within four weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase when RESIDENTIAL crosses below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has declined from -27.1% to -21.0%, indicating suppressed outdoor recreation. Concurrent with RETAIL_REC recovery, this suggests consumers are substituting outdoor recreation with indoor retail-recreation activities as weather or policy conditions shift.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved 6.1 percentage points while RETAIL_REC improved 4.9 percentage points
failure_condition: PARKS and RETAIL_REC do not move in the same direction over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines despite PARKS recovery.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has stabilized at -3.9% over two weeks. When combined with TRANSIT recovery above -3.0%, workplace commuting normalization creates sufficient foot traffic density to lift retail-recreation mobility above baseline within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves above -2.0% AND TRANSIT improves above -2.0% simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES stable at -3.9% in t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: Either WORKPLACES or TRANSIT fails to reach the specified thresholds, or RETAIL_REC does not increase by at least 2 percentage points within four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-August in Hong Kong marks the tail of summer school holidays and pre-autumn return-to-work period. RETAIL_REC recovery from -8.3% to -3.4% reflects holiday-driven shopping; this seasonal boost continues through late August before normalizing in September.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 4.9 percentage points over four weeks ending 2021-08-15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines in the week of 2021-08-22 or 2021-08-29, or fails to reach -1.0% by 2021-09-12.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM at 40.0% and RETAIL_REC at -3.4% indicate bifurcated mobility: essential shopping is strong while discretionary retail lags. If GROCERY_PHARM remains above 38% while TRANSIT improves above -2.0%, foot traffic concentration at essential destinations will spill over into adjacent retail-recreation zones, lifting RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays above 38% AND TRANSIT improves above -2.0%
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM at 40.0% and TRANSIT at -3.1% in t-0w
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 38% or TRANSIT remains below -2.0%, or RETAIL_REC does not increase by at least 1.5 percentage points within two weeks.
